excerpt: Compare ready and off-plan apartments in Ajman by inspection, payment timing, registration, handover and the cost of waiting.
introduction:
A ready Ajman apartment lets a buyer inspect an existing home and assess the building before purchase. An off-plan apartment is bought before completion, so the decision depends more heavily on the registered project, contract, payment schedule and delivery risk. Neither option is automatically cheaper or safer for every buyer.

Compare the same intended use and full budget. Include the cost of housing while an off-plan apartment is being built, the cash required at each milestone and the financial effect of a later handover. The calculation compares the payment schedules using a straightforward set of example figures.
takeaways: A ready unit can be inspected directly; an off-plan unit requires a close review of specifications and contractual protections.
Compare the dates and size of payments as well as the total price, fees and housing costs before handover.
Verify the relevant title or project registration, ownership right, payment recipient and transaction-specific charges.

sections.heading: What can you check before buying?
sections.body:
With a ready apartment, arrange an inspection of the unit and common areas. Check visible damp, cooling, water pressure, windows, lifts, access and the allocated parking. Request the title, service-charge statement, developer clearance and information about any tenant or mortgage affecting the sale. Ask how agreed repairs and outstanding charges will be handled before transfer.

For an off-plan apartment, examine the registered project, developer, unit number, floor plan, promised specification, payment triggers, expected completion and the consequences of a delay. A show apartment or promotional image may not be identical to the contracted unit. Keep the signed specification and ask how changes are documented.

Ajman's [real estate development law](https://ajmanre.gov.ae/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/Amiri-Decree-No-2-2020.pdf) describes a regulatory framework for off-plan projects within its scope, including project registration and escrow arrangements. Verify the current project status and payment account with the land department; the existence of an escrow process does not eliminate every delivery or contract risk.

sections.heading: Compare when cash leaves your account
sections.body:
Suppose, purely for illustration, that both apartments have a price of AED 600,000. A cash buyer of the ready unit pays that price at transfer, plus the confirmed transaction charges. The off-plan example assumes 10% at reservation, 30% during construction and 60% on handover. That is AED 60,000, AED 180,000 and AED 360,000 respectively, before any additional fees.

A smaller initial payment does not reduce the total price. The buyer must still have a credible plan for the construction instalments and the AED 360,000 handover balance. If the plan relies on a future mortgage or resale, test what happens if the bank declines the loan or a buyer cannot be found in time.

The chart illustrates price payments only. The pre-handover amount includes the reservation payment, so those two bars are not separate amounts to add together. Actual contracts differ and may use dates, construction milestones or other triggers.

sections.heading: Allow for the cost of waiting
sections.body:
If the buyer needs another home until handover, include rent and other housing costs for that period. For example, AED 40,000 a year for two years is AED 80,000 in rent before any other costs. The example shows how payment timing and housing costs interact during a purchase. A ready buyer may also face move-in costs and ongoing ownership expenses during those years, so include them on the other side of the comparison.

Then test a later handover. List the extra rent, any additional financing or storage costs and how the delay interacts with the buyer's existing lease. Read the contract and seek advice about the remedies and process that apply; do not assume an automatic refund or compensation from a generic rule.

An investor should also model the period before rent can begin, the time to find a tenant after completion and any work needed to prepare the unit. A target handover date is not the same as income received from a signed lease.

sections.heading: Understand initial and final registration
sections.body:
Ajman's [initial unit-sale registration service](https://www.ajman.ae/en/servicecatalog/services/3195) describes the developer's registration of an initial sale before all payments are completed. Ask when the certificate will be issued and whether the written unit and buyer details are correct. Confirm the fees and who pays them with the department and developer.

The separate [final-registration service](https://www.ajman.ae/en/servicecatalog/services/3197) relates to fully paid units in completed developments. It lists its own charges and document requirements. Do not add every figure from different service pages to every purchase without confirming whether each applies and whether an amount is already included in the contract.

For a ready resale, Ajman's [sale-registration service](https://www.ajman.ae/en/servicecatalog/services/3162) describes transfer documentation, including developer clearance for units. Confirm the exact buyer's fee, seller's obligations and any financing steps for the transaction.

sections.heading: Compare affordability and exit risk
sections.body:
For a ready home, ask for a bank illustration if financing is required, including valuation, fees, insurance and repayments after any introductory rate. For an off-plan payment plan, identify when finance is actually needed and whether the chosen lender will consider that specific project and buyer. Future approval is not guaranteed.

If you might sell before completion, examine the contract's transfer conditions, any outstanding instalments, developer consent and relevant charges. For a ready unit, consider the cost and time of selling, the existing tenant if any, and the possibility that the achieved price is below your purchase price.

Keep an emergency reserve after the planned payment. A comparison that leaves no money for a repair, delayed delivery or change in income can look attractive on paper while creating a difficult cash-flow problem.

sections.heading: Shortlist the right option for your plans
sections.body:
Start with the [Ajman area guide](/journal/ajman-property-2026), then explore the [Aliyas Ajman projects](/projects?emirate=Ajman) and request current availability for the type of apartment you want. Compare a real ready unit with a real off-plan schedule on the same worksheet; the website's project information is not a promise that a particular unit is available.

[Contact Aliyas](/contact) with your intended move date, budget and financing needs. Ask for the current contract documents, schedule and property-specific charges. Confirm the relevant ownership right and registration process with the authority before paying a reservation amount.
